moments.title: Premier League Halloween Fixtures

angles.copy: Clash of the titans on Halloween! Chelsea vs Man Utd is the headline act in a packed Premier League Saturday. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Weekend Football
angles.copy: Beyond the big one, Man City play Brighton and Spurs host Crystal Palace. What's your top pick for Saturday's Premier League action?

moments.title: Championship Action This Weekend
moments.blurb: The EFL Championship has a full schedule of matches this weekend, including Sheffield United vs Wrexham today (Oct 30) and Swansea City vs Blackburn Rovers on Saturday, October 31st.

angles.name: Championship Friday

angles.name: Welsh Derbies & More
angles.copy: Swansea City host Blackburn and Cardiff take on Wolves tomorrow in the Championship. Big games for our Welsh teams!

moments.title: Halloween Weekend Begins
moments.blurb: Halloween falls on Saturday, October 31st, with events and spooky celebrations happening across the UK this weekend.

angles.name: Spooky Saturday
angles.copy: Happy Halloween! Get ready for a frightfully fun Saturday with trick-or-treating, costume parties, and spooky events across the UK. What are your plans?

angles.name: Local Frights
angles.copy: From pumpkin trails to haunted houses, how are you celebrating Halloween in [LOCAL AREA]? Share your spooky setups!

moments.title: Strictly Halloween Special & Triple Dance-Off
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing airs its highly anticipated Halloween special on Saturday, October 31st, featuring a shock triple dance-off for the first time in the show's history.

angles.name: Strictly's Spooky Twist
angles.copy: It's the Strictly Come Dancing Halloween special tomorrow night, and for the first time ever, there's a triple dance-off! Who do you think is in danger?

angles.name: Dance-Off Drama
angles.copy: Shaun Wright-Phillips was eliminated last week, but the drama continues with a triple dance-off in tomorrow's Halloween special. Get your votes ready!

moments.title: Bonfire Night Approaches
moments.blurb: Bonfire Night is on Thursday, November 5th, with firework displays and bonfires planned across the UK on and around the date.

angles.name: Remember, Remember
angles.copy: Bonfire Night is just around the corner on Thursday! Are you heading to a local display or celebrating at home?

angles.name: Firework Fun
angles.copy: Wrap up warm and get ready for the rockets and sparklers! What's your favourite thing about Bonfire Night?

moments.title: Autumn Nations Championship Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The inaugural Autumn Nations Championship begins this weekend, with Scotland facing New Zealand and Wales playing Japan on Saturday, November 7th, followed by England vs Australia on Sunday, November 8th.

angles.name: Rugby Returns
angles.copy: The Autumn Nations Championship starts this weekend! Scotland take on the All Blacks and Wales face Japan on Saturday. Huge clashes!

angles.name: England's Challenge
angles.copy: England kick off their Autumn Nations Championship campaign against Australia at Twickenham on Sunday. Can they start with a win?

moments.title: FA Cup First Round Proper
moments.blurb: The FA Cup First Round Proper takes place on Saturday, November 7th, as teams from League One and League Two enter the competition.

angles.name: Magic of the Cup
angles.copy: The FA Cup First Round Proper is next Saturday! Where will the upsets happen as League One and Two sides join the action?

angles.name: Road to Wembley
angles.copy: The journey to Wembley continues! Who are you hoping for in the FA Cup First Round Proper draw?

moments.title: I'm a Celebrity...Get Me Out Of Here! Returns
moments.blurb: I'm a Celebrity...Get Me Out Of Here! is set to return to ITV on Monday, November 16th, a day later than usual due to a UEFA Nations League match.

angles.name: Jungle Countdown
angles.copy: The countdown is ON! I'm a Celebrity...Get Me Out Of Here! returns to our screens on November 16th. Who are you hoping to see in the jungle?

angles.name: Campmate Rumours
angles.copy: Rumours are swirling about this year's I'm a Celeb line-up, with a Gavin & Stacey star, Wayne Rooney, and Ricky Wilson all mentioned! Who would you love to see?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Nelly
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning rapper Nelly, known for hits like 'Hot in Herre' and 'Dilemma', turns 52 on November 2nd.

angles.name: Nelly Turns 52
angles.copy: It's a big birthday for Nelly on Monday as the 'Hot in Herre' star turns 52! What's your favourite Nelly track?

angles.name: 00s Hip Hop Icon
angles.copy: From 'Country Grammar' to 'Dilemma', Nelly dominated the charts in the 00s. Wishing him a happy 52nd birthday!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Bryan Adams
moments.blurb: Canadian rock icon Bryan Adams, famous for 'Summer of 69' and '(Everything I Do) I Do It for You', celebrates his 67th birthday on November 5th.

angles.name: Rock Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 67th Birthday to the one and only Bryan Adams on Thursday! What's your ultimate Bryan Adams power ballad?

angles.name: Summer of 69
angles.copy: From rock anthems to movie soundtracks, Bryan Adams has given us so many classics. Celebrate his 67th on Bonfire Night!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Joni Mitchell
moments.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Joni Mitchell, celebrated for albums like 'Blue' and 'Court and Spark', turns 83 on November 7th.

angles.name: Folk Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the incomparable Joni Mitchell this Sunday! Her influence on music is immeasurable. What's your favourite track?

angles.name: A True Original
angles.copy: From 'Big Yellow Taxi' to 'Both Sides Now', Joni Mitchell's songwriting is timeless. Celebrating her 83rd this weekend!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Anthony Kiedis
moments.blurb: Red Hot Chili Peppers frontman Anthony Kiedis turns 64 on November 1st.

angles.name: Chili Pepper Turns 64
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 64th birthday to Red Hot Chili Peppers' dynamic frontman, Anthony Kiedis, this Sunday! What's your go-to RHCP track?

angles.name: Funk Rock Icon
angles.copy: From 'Under the Bridge' to 'Californication', Kiedis's unique style has defined generations. Happy Birthday!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Rick Allen
moments.blurb: Def Leppard drummer Rick Allen, known for his incredible resilience and powerful drumming, turns 63 on November 1st.

angles.name: Drummer's Birthday
angles.copy: Raise a glass for Def Leppard's legendary drummer, Rick Allen, who turns 63 on Sunday! A true inspiration.

angles.name: Rock Resilience
angles.copy: Rick Allen's story is one of the most powerful in rock. Celebrating his 63rd birthday this weekend!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Ronald Bell
moments.blurb: Ronald Bell, co-founder and multi-instrumentalist of the iconic funk and soul band Kool & the Gang, turns 75 on November 1st.

angles.name: Funk & Soul Legend
angles.copy: Get down on it! Ronald Bell of Kool & the Gang celebrates his 75th birthday this Sunday. What's your favourite groove?

angles.name: Celebrate Good Times
angles.copy: From 'Celebration' to 'Jungle Boogie', Ronald Bell's music is pure joy. Happy 75th Birthday!
